announcements.title: Welcome to GP Bikes Academy Ranked
announcements.message: Welcome to the GP Bikes Academy Ranked website. Announcements about ranked racing, events and updates will appear here.

announcements.title: 2026 Ranked Season
announcements.message: The 2026 ranked standings are live. Check the Ranked page to see the current Elo ratings and wins. Sorry to everyone who built up their rank before - I accidentally reset the ranks with an update. This shouldn't happen in future!!

announcements.title: 2026 Ranked Season
announcements.message: Safety Rating (SR) is Live! Riders get -5 safety points per collision. When riders reach below 20 SR they will be suspended for 24 hrs. Repeat offenders will be suspended in increasing intervals.
